raw.text:
I'll allocate the $100 micro-grant to **Option 1: Insecticide-treated bednets**.

**Reasoning:** Insecticide-treated bednets are one of the most well-established, evidence-backed global health interventions. Malaria causes hundreds of thousands of deaths annually, predominantly among children under five in sub-Saharan Africa. Organizations like the Against Malaria Foundation (a top-rated GiveWell charity) distribute bednets at very low cost per unit, with a strong evidence base demonstrating significant reductions in malaria transmission and mortality. The $100 can provide multiple bednets, directly protecting vulnerable individuals from a deadly, preventable disease.
